title: 优步148亿美元收购外卖平台Delivery Hero
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Ed, I also want to ask you about the Uber deal. It seems pretty complicated.
segments.zh: Ed，我还想问一下优步的交易，看起来相当复杂。

segments.en: It's a bunch of delivery your markets going to Uber, and a bunch more going to private equity.
segments.zh: 一部分外卖市场将归优步，另一部分归私募股权。

segments.en: Explain it to us. Yeah, I mean, in this case, very simply, Uber has agreed officially confirmation to a buy delivery hero, 41 euros and 50 cents a share.
segments.zh: 简单来说，优步已正式确认以每股41.50欧元收购Delivery Hero。

segments.en: And it's a big premium to their attempt earlier in the summer or in the spring in May.
segments.zh: 相比今年春季5月的尝试，这次溢价很高。

segments.en: Why would Uber do this? The same reason that all of Uber and its smaller peers have looked at M&A, it puts you into markets
segments.zh: 优步为何这么做？和所有小型同行一样，并购能进入新市场。

segments.en: that you're not already in. So in delivery heroes case, 50 markets that they have operations in.
And it gives Uber something particularly outside of America, right?
segments.zh: 这给优步带来了美国以外的市场，对吧？

segments.en: I think there's like a lack of an understanding really about how these companies operate XUS.
segments.zh: 我认为人们不太了解这些公司在美国以外的运营方式。

segments.en: The complication on the funding side is that it's cash debt.
segments.zh: 融资方面的复杂之处在于它是现金债务。
有一笔140亿美元的过桥贷款。

segments.en: And separately, SSW partners is going to acquire some of delivery hero's markets
segments.zh: 另外，SSW Partners将收购Delivery Hero的部分市场，

segments.en: that Uber isn't going to take. Well, if it gets the deal done, you know?
segments.zh: 这些市场Uber不会接手。如果交易成功的话，你懂的？
